name: Crossover_2EMA
summary: This EA implements a dual EMA crossover trend-following strategy using the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework. It generates buy signals when the fast EMA crosses above the slow EMA and sell signals on the opposite crossover. Position sizing is handled by a fixed lot money management module with no trailing stop applied.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MQL5标准库Expert框架实现双EMA交叉趋势跟踪策略。当快速EMA上穿慢速EMA时产生买入信号，反之产生卖出信号。仓位管理采用固定手数资金管理模块，不使用移动止损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的双指数移动平均线(EMA)交叉策略作为核心交易逻辑，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为快速EMA(默认12周期)上穿慢速EMA(默认24周期)时做多，快速EMA下穿慢速EMA时做空。出场条件依赖于信号反向交叉触发平仓，因为没有配置移动止损模块(TrailingNone)，持仓将一直保持直到反向信号出现。仓位管理采用固定手数方式(CMoneyFixedLot)，默认手数为0.1，资金管理百分比为10%。该策略没有设置止损和止盈，完全依赖信号反转来退出头寸，这在震荡行情中可能导致较大回撤。整体架构基于MQL5标准库的CExpert框架，模块化程度高，信号、移动止损、资金管理各自独立。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic dual Exponential Moving Average (EMA) crossover strategy as its core trading logic, representing a typical trend-following system. Entry conditions are a buy when the fast EMA (default period 12) crosses above the slow EMA (default period 24), and a sell on the opposite crossover. Exit conditions rely on the signal reversing via crossover since no trailing stop module is configured (TrailingNone), meaning positions are held until an opposing signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default lot size of 0.1 and a money management percentage of 10%. The strategy lacks explicit stop-loss and take-profit levels, depending entirely on signal reversal for position closure, which can lead to significant drawdowns during ranging markets. The overall architecture is built on the MQL5 Standard Library CExpert framework, offering high modularity with signal, trailing, and money management as independent components.

parameters.name: Inp_Money_FixLot_Percent
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage for fixed lot money management

pros: 基于MQL5标准库框架，代码结构清晰，模块化程度高，易于维护和扩展
双EMA交叉策略逻辑简单直观，适合趋势行情，回测和参数优化方便
信号、移动止损、资金管理三大模块独立解耦，可以方便地替换或升级任一模块
pros_en: Built on the MQL5 Standard Library framework with clear code structure, high modularity, and easy maintenance and extensibility
The dual EMA crossover logic is simple and intuitive, well-suited for trending markets, and facilitates straightforward backtesting and parameter optimization
Signal, trailing, and money management modules are independently decoupled, allowing easy replacement or upgrade of any single module
cons: 没有设置止损和止盈，在震荡行情中会频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少新K线检查(EveryTick=false有帮助但不充分)，可能在同一根K线内重复开仓
双EMA交叉策略属于滞后指标，入场时机偏晚，容易在趋势末期才进场
cons_en: No stop-loss or take-profit configured, leading to consecutive losses from frequent false signals during ranging markets
Lacks explicit new bar check (EveryTick=false helps but is insufficient), potentially opening duplicate positions within the same bar
Dual EMA crossover is inherently a lagging indicator, causing late entries that often coincide with trend exhaustion
improvements: 增加止损和止盈参数，或至少启用移动止损模块以限制单笔亏损
添加ADX或成交量过滤器，在震荡行情中抑制虚假交叉信号
improvements_en: Add stop-loss and take-profit parameters, or at least enable a trailing stop module to limit per-trade losses
Add an ADX or volume filter to suppress false crossover signals during ranging or low-momentum markets

risk_points: 无止损止盈设置，单笔亏损可能无限扩大
震荡行情中EMA交叉频繁产生虚假信号，可能导致连续开平仓亏损
risk_points_en: No stop-loss or take-profit, allowing single-trade losses to grow unbounded
EMA crossovers frequently generate false signals in ranging markets, potentially causing consecutive open-close losses
